audience: store owners and developers who run a headless commerce store on Swell

useCases.title: Review orders and revenue for a period
useCases.text: The AI lists orders with filters and sorting and adds up their totals for the period. You can also open a single order by id or order number.

useCases.title: Find products that are inactive or hidden
useCases.text: The AI lists products with filters, search and field selection, and shows which ones are inactive. It can also list categories.

useCases.title: Count abandoned carts and look at customers
useCases.text: The AI lists shopping carts, including abandoned ones, and customers (accounts) with filters. You see who left a cart and how many abandoned carts there are.

useCases.title: Check subscriptions, invoices and coupons
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions, subscription invoices and discount coupons with filters and sorting. You get an overview of recurring revenue and discounts.

useCases.title: Create or update products and update orders
useCases.text: The AI creates a product, changes fields of a product, or updates an order, for example its status or notes. These changes happen on the live store.
